title: Opencode Direct CIEL Coupling
description: Python runtime adapter that couples opencode directly to CIELingo and CielEngine without file I/O for state. Projects Adrian's input through build_lingo_frame(), steps the engine with opencode-tagged context (fast=False — ~35s on first CielEngine init), or returns enriched state directly (fast=True — ~0.7s after orbital_bridge cache warmup). Cache: build_orbital_bridge caches at module level with 600s TTL. Critical path: orbital_bridge no longer calls run_global_pass(steps=2000) — reduced to 20 steps (~0.3s). KIEDYŚ: dwa osobne CielEngine singletony (ciel_coupling._get_engine + ciel_pipeline._get_engine) — każde pierwsze step() ~35s. Z fast=True całość <1s po cache.

field_contract.state_transport: direct Python API coupling, no file-backed state exchange

known_issues: dual CielEngine singleton (ciel_coupling vs ciel_pipeline) — each first step ~35s
